# Endpoint cross-check (generated by `scripts/endpoint_crosscheck.py`)

403 registry endpoints use 104 distinct routes. A cell marks the references that name the route (placeholders compared blanked out). Parameters are what the references document; they do not document response column types, so every column type is confirmed by the live-probed samples (`docs/mlb_probe.json`, `tests/fixtures/mlb`), not by these documents. Matching is textual, so a route a reference spells in another way (a version placeholder, a method name) is listed as found live only.
